correctness.rationale: C PASS. N=binom(n,r), M=binom(n−1,r), u=2r−t and K_t= N binom(r,t)binom(n−r,r−t)/2. Conditional on a vertex being isolated, the m edges are a uniform subset of M avoiding edges; the proportion of t-overlap pairs also avoiding it is (n−u)/n. Hence Cov/(EI ET)=(n−u)N(N−1)/[nM(M−1)]−1. Expanding with M=(n−r)N/n yields the claimed expression. For nt≥r² numerator positive; for nt<r² write d=r²−nt≥1 and use binom(n,r)≥n(r−t) with the only equality n=5,r=3,t=1 occurring at d=4, so numerator strictly negative. Domain exclusions ensure both expectations positive; degeneracies m<2,n<u,m>M have zero covariance. Independent full finite fixed-edge enumeration checks negative n=5,7,8 and positive n=9 for r=3,t=1, including ratios −1/34 at n=8 and +1/165 at n=9.
